title: Your Parallaxa
intro: Choose where and what you care about. We narrow by place and topic only, never by side: every story still shows every side.

places.title: Places
places.help: Up to 5. One is your home (used for the perception quiz and local context).
places.max: You can choose up to 5 places.

topics.title: Topics
topics.help: Followed topics come first. Muted topics are left out of the briefing and alerts, never out of Check.

briefing.title: Daily briefing
briefing.outsideHelp: A major event outside your places or topics, so personalization doesn't become a bubble.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: At most one routine notification a day, plus updates you asked for (up to 3).
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. On iPhone, add Parallaxa to your home screen first.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.help: Without an account, everything here stays on this device.

preview: With these settings, today's briefing would include:

account.title: Account (optional)
account.intro: You don't need an account. Create one only to keep your places, topics and follows in sync across devices. No email or password: just a passkey on your device (fingerprint, face or PIN).
account.disabled: Accounts are not enabled on this server.
account.addPasskey: Add a passkey to this account
account.passkeys: {count, plural, =0 {No passkeys yet} one {# passkey} other {# passkeys}}
account.syncUp: Save this device's settings to my account
account.syncDown: Load my account's settings on this device
account.deleteConfirm: Type DELETE to permanently delete your account. This cannot be undone.
account.selfIntro: Helps us check that Parallaxa is trusted equally across the spectrum. Stored separately and encrypted, used only in anonymous groups of at least 50 people, and deletable at any time.
account.selfConsent: I explicitly consent to Parallaxa storing my political self-placement for these aggregate statistics.
account.passkeyIntro: Your passkey stays on your device and syncs through your phone or computer’s password manager. We never learn who you are.
account.create: Create an account with a passkey
account.passkeyFailed: That didn’t work. Try again, or use a device that supports passkeys.
